pages.text: One sunny morning, Bruno the bear cub woke up very hungry. “Pancakes!” he said. “I want pancakes!”
But Bruno's kitchen was almost empty. He had flour, but no eggs, no milk, no honey. Bruno looked very sad.
Pip the hedgehog knocked on the door. “Why so sad, Bruno?” “I have no eggs,” said Bruno.
“Let's ask our friends!” said Pip. So they walked to Nana's house together.
Nana the rabbit had two big eggs. “Here you are!” she said with a happy hop.
Coco the duckling brought a jug of milk. But Coco tripped at the kitchen door! Oh no!
Splash! The milk flew up... and landed right in the bowl. “Lucky duck!” everyone laughed.
Wise old Olive the owl came with honey. “A little honey makes everything sweet,” she said.
They mixed and mixed. Flip! Bruno turned the pancakes in the pan.
Soon the little kitchen smelled warm and sweet. The pancakes were golden and round.
“Thank you, friends,” said Bruno. “Pancakes taste best when we share them.”
So the five friends ate pancakes together, and every plate was soon empty.
